title: Rearview mirror camera and side mirror mentions
summary: Feedback about mirrors centers on requests for a digital rearview mirror or rear camera display, with a smaller set of comments about damaged or folding side mirrors.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight interest in a rearview mirror camera display for blocked rear visibility and appreciation for mirror-related convenience ideas.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention driver-side mirror damage or problems tied to the side mirror location.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback praises power-folding side mirrors for reducing the chance of being hit or damaged.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly describe desired digital rearview mirror or camera functionality, but the sample often lacks enough context to classify the sentiment reliably.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confident interpretation of overall sentiment.
Several excerpts are truncated or phrased as feature requests, so intent and sentiment are sometimes unclear.
The topic combines rearview mirror camera-display requests with separate side-mirror condition comments, so it is not fully uniform.
